Hero.Title: Our approach
Hero.Description: Ridger is an independent family office, aligned with your interests. We coordinate, consolidate and oversee, without ever managing your assets in place of your banks and managers.

Sections.Title: Independence
Body: We are neither a bank nor an asset manager. This independence is the condition for an objective view of your financial relationships.
Our compensation is transparent and aligned with your interest. We have no product to place and no transaction to prompt.

Sections.Title: Method
Body: We begin with an audit of your existing setup: banking relationships, mandates, structures and advisors.
We then put in place the consolidation of your wealth, followed by a rhythm of oversight and coordination suited to your priorities.

Sections.Title: Discretion and security
Body: Confidentiality is at the heart of our work. Your data is hosted in Switzerland and shared only with the people you designate.
Our digital-first workflows preserve traceability and access control at every step.

Sections.Title: A single point of contact
Body: You have one point of contact who knows your files and mobilises the right skills at the right time.
We reply within one business day and keep the memory of your decisions over time.

ArkNote: Ridger is backed by an established Geneva fiduciary group, a mark of rigour and continuity:
